hello.note: Literally 'peace'. More respectful, e.g. to elders: ጤና ይስጥልኝ (tena yistilign).

goodbye.note: To a man: ደህና ሁን (dehna hun); to a woman: ደህና ሁኚ (dehna hugni). Casual: ቻው (chaw).

please.note: Polite form for strangers. To a man: እባክህ (ibakih); to a woman: እባክሽ (ibakish).

thank_you.note: Thanks a lot: በጣም አመሰግናለሁ (betam ameseginalehu). Also common: እግዚአብሔር ይስጥልኝ (igziabher yistilign).

youre_welcome.note: Literally 'it's nothing'. In quick speech often shortened to ምንም አይደል (minim aydel).

yes.note: To agree to a request, say እሺ (ishi), 'OK'. People also say yes with a quick intake of breath.

no.note: Fuller: አይ፣ አይደለም (ay, aydelem), 'no, it isn't'. 'There isn't any': የለም (yelem).

sorry.note: Same word as 'excuse me'. A fuller apology: ይቅርታ ያድርጉልኝ (yikirta yadirgulign).

excuse_me.note: Same word as 'sorry'. Before asking a stranger something, ጤና ይስጥልኝ (tena yistilign) is also polite.

good_morning.note: To a man: እንደምን አደርክ (indemin aderk); to a woman: እንደምን አደርሽ (indemin adersh).

how_are_you.note: To a man: እንዴት ነህ? (indet neh?); to a woman: እንዴት ነሽ? (indet nesh?)

im_fine.note: Very common: ደህና ነኝ፣ እግዚአብሔር ይመስገን (dehna negn, igziabher yimesgen), 'fine, thank God'.

whats_your_name.note: Amharic asks 'who' (ማን) is your name. To a man: ስምህ (simih); to a woman: ስምሽ (simish).

where_from.note: To a man: ከየት ነህ? (keyet neh?); to a woman: ከየት ነሽ? (keyet nesh?)

im_from.note: ከ (ke-) 'from' joins the country: ከጀርመን ነኝ (keJermen negn), 'I'm from Germany'.

speak_english.note: Everyday: እንግሊዝኛ ይችላሉ? (inglizigna yichilalu?), 'can you [do] English?'

dont_understand.note: Please repeat that: እባክዎ ይድገሙት (ibakwo yidgemut).

speak_slowly.note: To a man: እባክህ ቀስ ብለህ ተናገር (ibakih kes bileh tenager).

where.note: Where is …?: … የት ነው? (… yet new?)

what.note: Didn't catch it? Say ምን አሉ? (min alu?), 'what did you say?' (polite).

how_much.note: Also: ዋጋው ስንት ነው? (wagaw sint new?), 'what's the price?'

where_bathroom.note: More everyday but blunter: ሽንት ቤት (shint bet).

can_you_help.note: To a man: ልትረዳኝ ትችላለህ? (litredagn tichilaleh?)

what_time.note: Ethiopian time counts from 6 a.m., so 7 a.m. is 'one o'clock' (አንድ ሰዓት). Check which clock is meant.

three.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፫. Also spelled ሶስት.

ten.note: Ethiopic numeral: ፲. Also spelled አስር.

coffee.note: Coffee with milk: ማኪያቶ (makiato), hugely popular.

bread.note: The staple flatbread is እንጀራ (injera); ዳቦ is ordinary bread.

delicious.note: Also: ጣፋጭ ነው! (tafach new!). ጣፋጭ can also mean 'sweet'.

no_meat.note: Ask for የጾም ምግብ (yetsom migib), 'fasting food': vegan dishes, easy to find.

enjoy_meal.note: At the table people also invite each other with እንብላ! (inbila!), 'let's eat!'

left.note: To the left: ወደ ግራ (wede gira).

right.note: To the right: ወደ ቀኝ (wede kegn).

straight_ahead.note: Go straight on: ቀጥ ብለው ይሂዱ (ket bilew yihidu).

stop_here.note: In a shared minibus, call out ወራጅ አለ! (weraj ale!), 'someone's getting off!'

airport.note: Everyday: ኤርፖርት (erport). In Addis Ababa people often just say ቦሌ (Bole).

hotel.note: In Ethiopia ሆቴል is also used for a restaurant.

is_it_far.note: Is it close?: ቅርብ ነው? (kirb new?)

cheaper.note: To haggle: ትንሽ ይቀንሱልኝ (tinish yikensulign), 'bring the price down a little'.

id_like_this.note: I'll take this: ይሄንን እወስዳለሁ (yihenin iwesdalehu).

small.note: Also means 'a little': ትንሽ ውሃ (tinish wiha), 'a little water'.

good_evening.note: To a man: እንደምን አመሸህ (indemin amesheh); to a woman: እንደምን አመሸሽ (indemin ameshesh).

good_night.note: To a man: ደህና እደር (dehna ider); to a woman: ደህና እደሪ (dehna ideri).

wait_moment.note: Casual, to a man: አንዴ ቆይ (ande koy); to a woman: አንዴ ቆዪ (ande koyi).

call_police.note: To one man: ፖሊስ ጥራ! (polis tira!). Here ጥሩ means 'call', not 'good'.

im_lost.note: Literally 'the road got lost on me'.

allergic.note: ለ (le-) joins the allergen: ለወተት አለርጂ አለብኝ (lewetet alerji alebign), 'allergic to milk'.

be_careful.note: To a man: ተጠንቀቅ! (tetenkek!); to a woman: ተጠንቀቂ! (tetenkeki!)

i_like_it.note: Also: ደስ ይለኛል (des yilegnal), 'it pleases me'.

im_happy.note: Describing yourself as a happy person: ደስተኛ ነኝ (destegna negn).

welcome.note: To a man: እንኳን ደህና መጣህ! (inkwan dehna metah!); to a woman: እንኳን ደህና መጣሽ! (inkwan dehna metash!)

congratulations.note: To a man: እንኳን ደስ አለህ! (inkwan des aleh!); to a woman: እንኳን ደስ አለሽ! (inkwan des alesh!)
